# Shopify D2C OMS Canonical Card Pack — V17 Semantic Curated

## 0. Issue Register and Curation Notes

```yaml
issue_register:
- issue_id: semantic_curation_v17_shopify
  status: resolved
  resolution: Rewrote semantic fields from Shopify source facts and added linked-rule/use-boundary qualifiers while
    preserving v17 edge coverage.
```

## 1. Introduction and Scope Boundary

This reusable Shopify D2C OMS pack is grounded in the Shopify OMS source document and the Shopify sections of the OMS Business Knowledge Base. Runtime tenant, account, payment-gateway, bank, courier, and statutory cards remain out of scope.

## 2. Validation Contract

Locked v17 validation applies: universal semantic profiles, SQL blueprint checks, claim consistency, and deterministic edge coverage.

      dialect: athena_trino
      execution_status: template_ready
      grain: overall
      runtime_scope_policy: runtime_filters_from_account_binding_only
      runtime_parameters:
      - name: group_level_id
        required: false
        type: integer
        source: runtime_account_binding
        description: Optional runtime scope injected from client account binding.
      - name: start_date
        required: false
        type: date
        source: user_input
        description: Optional lower date bound.
      - name: end_date
        required: false
        type: date
        source: user_input
        description: Optional upper date bound.
      required_tables:
      - table.zs_observe.shopify_oms
      required_columns:

      - column.zs_observe.shopify_oms.financial_status
      - column.zs_observe.shopify_oms.payment_mode

      - column.zs_observe.shopify_oms.created_date
      - column.zs_observe.shopify_oms.group_level_id
      template: 'SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN financial_status = ''pending'' OR payment_mode = ''cash_on_delivery''
        THEN order_id END) AS cod_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS total_orders, 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
        WHEN financial_status = ''pending'' OR payment_mode = ''cash_on_delivery'' THEN order_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT
        order_id), 0) AS cod_share_pct FROM zs_observe.shopify_oms WHERE is_active = true /* optional_runtime_filter:
        created_date >= :start_date */ /* optional_runtime_filter: created_date < :end_date */ /* optional_runtime_filter:
        group_level_id = :group_level_id */'
      ctes: []
      joins: []
      filters:
      - expression: is_active = true
        filter_type: mandatory_quality_filter
        source: query_pattern
        required: true
      - expression: group_level_id = :group_level_id
        filter_type: runtime_scope_filter
        source: runtime_account_binding
        required: false
      group_by: []
      having: []
      order_by: []
      output_columns:
      - name: cod_orders
        source: metric
        canonical_id: metric.shopify.cod_order_count
        meaning: Distinct COD order count.
      - name: total_orders
        source: metric
        canonical_id: metric.shopify.order_count
        meaning: All distinct Shopify orders.
      - name: cod_share_pct
        source: expression
        canonical_id: null
        meaning: COD orders as a percent of total orders.
      safety_rules:
      - Always apply is_active = true.
      - Runtime scope must be injected from account bindings, not hardcoded.
      - Cast text amount fields before aggregation where documented.
      output_contract_id: output_contract.shopify.standard_metric_result
      scope_columns:
      - column.zs_observe.shopify_oms.is_active
      - column.zs_observe.shopify_oms.group_level_id
      date_basis: created_date
      operation_shape: ratio_report
      filter_plan:
      - stage: quality_filter
        expression: is_active = true
        filter_type: mandatory_quality_filter
        required: true
        source: rule.shopify.is_active_filter
      - stage: runtime_scope

        filter_type: runtime_scope_filter
        required: false
        source: runtime_account_binding
      - stage: runtime_date
        expression: created_date >= :start_date and created_date < :end_date
        filter_type: date_filter
        required: false
        source: user_input

      pre_aggregation:
      - stage: source_grain_check
        purpose: Aggregate Shopify order-line rows to order_id before order-level metrics or before joining to shipment/refund
          actuals.
        grain: order_id
        required: false
      normalization:
        join_key_normalization: Normalize Shopify hash prefixes, order-name forms, and Shiprocket hyphen suffixes
          only when a relationship or matching logic requires it.
        amount_sign_policy: Shopify order amounts are positive source values; refund values are positive refund
          records and must not be netted unless the metric formula says so.
        concat_keys:
        - not_required
      grain_assertion: Result grain is overall and must not be mixed with order-line grain without explicit aggregation.
    domain_id: domain.shopify.payment_state

      - Cast text amount fields before aggregation where documented.
      output_contract_id: output_contract.shopify.standard_metric_result

        join_keys:
        - order_id prefix to Shiprocket suffixed order_id

        expression: is_active = true
        filter_type: mandatory_quality_filter

        source: rule.shopify.is_active_filter
